limitations.note: The counter fix was correct, but the square-wave rewrite overwrote the previous output between counts 9 and 19 instead of holding it, changing what happens when entering square mode.
The triangle rewrite changed startup and mode-entry behavior: after reset, its first triangle sample is 1, whereas the reference preserves the original decrement from 0 to 31.

The test explicitly expected the rewritten triangle startup and did not check whether entering square mode with a nonzero output held that value until count 9, so it passed despite both behavior changes.
